page: Microsoft Azure E20pds_v5 is an ARM-based virtual machine belonging to the EPDSv5 server family. It is powered by an Ampere Altra ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor running at 3.0 GHz, featuring 20 dedicated physical cores and 20 vCPUs with no hyperthreading. The server is equipped with 160.0 GB of memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It also includes 768 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark results place the E20pds_v5 in the average performance tier for most workloads. It achieves a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 36030.32 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 10649.0. Memory performance is solid, with a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1405.13 GB/sec and a large block uncached write bandwidth of 73.73 GB/sec. However, single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by a Geekbench single-core score of 1109.0 and a weak bzip3 single-threaded decompression speed of 8.7 GB/sec.

Given its 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated ARM cores, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that benefit from predictable, non-shared CPU resources. It is well-suited for database operations, as demonstrated by its Passmark database score of 13959.39 and Redis SET throughput of 28.38 million operations per second. Other appropriate workloads include static web serving, software compilation, and light language model inference using smaller models.
